title: The haul
narration: We came for what the planet held beneath its surface. Minerals. Metals. Enough to fill the hold. Ten miners, one ship, and one last haul before home.
alt: A weathered mining ship rests on a rocky planet. Miners gather crystals and raw materials, then load full cargo crates aboard.

title: Behind the stones
narration: Beyond the landing lights, two things watched us work. When two of our crew strayed behind the stones, the things hid. Then they struck.
alt: Two dark alien organisms watch from behind boulders. Two miners approach; the creatures hide and spring an ambush.

title: Borrowed faces
narration: They entered our crewmates and learned their shapes. Their faces. Their size. Even their clothes. What walked back to the ship looked exactly like the people we knew.
alt: The aliens enter the two fallen miners and emerge as perfect copies of their bodies, faces and work suits. The copies leave the original bodies behind.

title: Ten aboard
narration: We counted ten aboard. Closed the hatch. Left the planet behind. No one saw the two bodies lying in the dust, beyond the reach of our landing lights.
alt: Eight human miners and two indistinguishable mimics board. The ship lifts into space while the two original miners lie dead behind the rocks.

title: Something wrong
narration: Out among the stars, things began to fail. Something was wrong aboard our ship. The medbay scanner could show what a face could hide. We would repair it, then check everyone. One by one.
alt: The ship crosses a starfield. Worried crew inspect failing systems and turn toward the medbay X-ray scanner.

title: Proof of humanity
narration: We rebuilt the X-ray device. Every connection restored. Every test passed. At last, we had a way to tell who was human. For a moment, we thought we were safe.
alt: Crew reconnect and repair the scanner. It powers up successfully, shows a human test scan, and the crew prepare to be examined individually.

title: Sabotage
narration: Then the medbay emptied. One crewmate slipped back inside. A familiar hand became something else. Wires snapped. The scanner went dark. Something aboard did not want to be found.
alt: The repaired medbay is left empty. A mimic enters alone, transforms its hand and rips out the scanner wiring. Sparks fade as the device goes dark.

title: MIMIC
alt: MIMIC title on a dark starfield.
